name: week
title: Fundraising week
subtitle: Read-only snapshot. Fictional demo until you import your own records.

sections.title: Pledges due
sections.sql: select name,donor,currency,balance,due_date from pledge_balances where balance>0 and status='open' and due_date<=current_date+30 order by due_date

sections.title: Stewardship and permission
sections.sql: select name,donor,channel,due_date,contact_status from stewardship_queue order by due_date

sections.title: Campaign progress
sections.sql: select name,currency,goal,received,outstanding,cash_gap from campaign_results order by name

sections.title: Restricted gifts received
sections.note: Receipts only, not available fund balance. Expenditure remains in your accounts.
sections.sql: select name,restricted,purpose,currency,received from fund_totals order by name

sections.title: Record exceptions
sections.sql: select * from compliance_findings order by rule,record
